messages:
Asha (People Ops): Quick thread — I put together a compact manager onboarding checklist for new managers who join teams. Goal is a 1-week actionable agenda + 30/60/90 template. Feedback? :eye:
Marcus (Eng Manager): Nice, can you share the short version I can paste into calendar invites?
Asha (People Ops): Yep — here's a one-week agenda you can copy into meetings:
Asha (People Ops): ```
Day 0 (before start): IT access, Slack invite, payroll form, org chart
Day 1: Welcome + intro to team (30m), Admin + accounts (30m), 1:1 with manager (30m)
Day 2: Systems walkthrough (confluence/infra) (45m), Product overview (30m)
Day 3: People Ops sync (30m), Hiring/compensation overview (30m)
Day 4: Role kickoff: goals + success metrics (1h), Meet cross-functional partners (30m)
Day 5: 30/60/90 draft + feedback (1h), Quick retro on week (30m)
``` 
Priya (HR): Love the compactness. For managers specifically we recommend adding a hiring calibration touchpoint in week 1.
Marcus (Eng Manager): Got it. Where's the 30/60/90 template?
Asha (People Ops): Short template below — managers should co-create with hires in week 1.
Asha (People Ops): ```
30 days: Learn systems, build relationships, deliver quick win
60 days: Own a feature, improve a process, mentor peers
90 days: Drive roadmap item, deliver measurable impact, hire/plan
Owners: manager/new hire
Check-ins: weekly 1:1s + monthly sync
``` 
Jon (New Hire): Thanks — this is super helpful. IT setup stuck on VPN onboarding.
ITBot: @Jon — VPN ticket created #IT-789, ETA 2 business days. Please follow the VPN guide: https://intranet.redwood/vpn
Jon (New Hire): Thanks @ITBot, pinged IT too.
Sam (Recruiter): FYI — I'll set up intro emails to key stakeholders during day 1.
Lina (People Ops): Asha — can we add a short checklist for security training completion (SAML + data handling)?
Asha (People Ops): Yep — add a 15m slot on Day 2 for Security & Compliance. I'll update the doc.
Marcus (Eng Manager): One more ask: add 'codebase walkthrough' for eng new managers, 45m.
Asha (People Ops): Done — thanks. I'll post a clean copy in the onboarding docs repo and link here.
Asha (People Ops): https://docs.redwood.onboarding/manager-week1-compact
Marcus (Eng Manager): Perfect. :thumbsup:
Priya (HR): If no objections I'll publish this as the 'Manager Quickstart (Week 1)' template tomorrow.
Marcus (Eng Manager): No objections from me.
Jon (New Hire): Appreciate everyone — excited to start next week! :rocket:
